item.title: TraceAnything
item.description:
The Problem
Videos are typically processed as sequences of independent frames or as static 3D reconstructions, which loses temporal continuity. Tracking arbitrary points across a video—whether for editing, 3D reconstruction, or scene understanding—requires either expensive per-frame correspondence matching or specialized trackers that don't generalize well.
